findings.description: When ANSI stripping applies, the prompt text is also stripped of leading and trailing whitespace, which the commit title does not mention.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt such as 'Name: ' is shown on a non-tty stream or under CliRunner, where should_strip_ansi returns true. Mechanism: strip_ansi(text).strip() removes the trailing space, so the prompt becomes 'Name:'. Impact: non-interactive or test output shows the prompt without the separating space, a small visible change beyond stripping ANSI codes.
